_comment: release.json — the update policy for every installed B.A.B.I.
This file is published to the PUBLIC repo motta22/babi-releases and read by every
installed app from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/motta22/babi-releases/main/release.json?t=<epoch>
The query string defeats GitHub's raw cache, which is about five minutes.
Publish it AFTER the release assets are uploaded, never before. A release.json that
announces a version whose installer does not exist yet sends every installed app into a
failing update loop.
What each field does to an app that is already running on someone's PC:
latest       The newest shell version. The app compares it with its own
app.getVersion(). If it is behind, the update flow starts at the level
below.
minSupported The oldest shell version still allowed to run normally. An app below
this goes blocking even when level says optional. Use it to retire a
build that is merely old.
pageVersion  The Command Center version this shell expects. The shell reads the
loaded page's <meta name="jarvis-page-version"> and compares. A page
below pageVersion gets the republish card: nothing we control can push
a new page into a user's account, so it has to be visible instead.
level        optional  download in the background, install on the next quit, one
quiet line from B.A.B.I and nothing else.
required  download at once; the user may postpone three launches or
24 hours, whichever comes first, with a visible countdown;
then it becomes blocking by itself.
blocking  full-screen update card, install, relaunch. No work happens
first. B.A.B.I says so out loud before he does it.
message      One sentence, in the user's words, shown on the update card and spoken.
Say what they get, not what changed internally.
notesUrl     The release notes. Linked from the card.
blockBelow   The kill switch. Any version below this refuses to run at all and shows
message. null in normal times. Set it for a release that is unsafe, not
merely old — it leaves users with an app that will not start.
Rhythm for a normal release: publish with level optional, watch Issues for 24 hours,
then raise to required. Never publish a lower latest: rollback is roll-forward.
This _comment key is ignored by the app. Keep it here; the next person to edit this
file under pressure will need it.
minHub       (Phase F) The oldest HUB version a device on this release can talk to. A device whose
hub is older says 'your hub needs updating' and offers to ask it (plan §10.2).
minClient    (Phase F) The oldest pocket client / Android app / device-mode PC the hub accepts.
A device below it can only send STOP until it updates.
signature    (Phase F, D13) ed25519 over the canonical JSON of every other field (comments
excluded), made on the hub with the OFFLINE key: node scripts/sign-release.mjs.
Every app checks it against release/policy-public-key.txt before offering anything.
sha512       The installer's fingerprint, filled in by scripts/sign-release.mjs from dist/latest.yml. An
installed app downloads only the installer with this sha512; a GitHub release that differs is
refused. So: build and upload first, sign second, publish this file last.
message: Your assistant can now update itself and its Command Center with one button, muting really closes the microphone, and many screens got smoother.
